captions.caption: A soldier in desert camouflage aims his rifle towards a dense patch of tall green grass.
The soldier keeps his weapon raised, peering through the optics while standing on a dirt path.
He remains stationary, carefully scanning the vegetation for any sign of movement.
The soldier maintains a focused aim, his finger near the trigger, ready to respond.
He slightly shifts his stance, keeping the rifle pointed steadily at the target area.
The soldier begins to lower his rifle as he turns his body slightly to the left.
He uses his left hand to gesture while speaking to other soldiers who are off-camera.
The soldier continues to talk, pointing his hand toward the trees in the distance.
He turns around completely and starts walking away from the camera along the path.
The soldier walks along the edge of the tall grass, his gear clinking as he moves.
He continues walking down the dirt path, heading away from the initial observation point.
The soldier moves further into the distance, with the lush green landscape surrounding him.
The camera pans across the rural setting, showing more of the fields and trees.
A soldier is seen crouching behind a low dirt embankment, aiming his rifle.
He looks through the scope of his weapon, focusing on something across the field.
The soldier stays low, using the embankment for cover while he observes.
He maintains a steady aim, his rifle resting on the edge of the dirt mound.
The soldier continues to scan the horizon through his rifle's optics.
He shifts his position slightly, keeping his eyes fixed on the distant target.
The soldier begins to lower his weapon and looks around his immediate area.
He stays in a crouched position, checking his surroundings before moving.
The soldier starts to stand up, gripping his rifle firmly with both hands.
He is now fully standing, with a large backpack visible on his back.
The soldier turns away from the embankment and begins to walk.
He walks towards a green field, his rifle held in a ready position across his chest.
The soldier continues his walk, moving through the open agricultural land.
He maintains a steady pace, looking from side to side as he patrols.
The soldier walks past a row of green plants, heading towards the center of the field.
He continues to move forward, with the vast landscape stretching out before him.
The soldier walks out of the frame as he continues his mission.
A soldier is shown jogging quickly along a rocky berm next to a field.
He carries his rifle and moves with purpose, scanning the area as he runs.
The soldier gestures with his hand, possibly signaling to other members of his team.
He continues his rapid movement, navigating the uneven and rocky ground.
The soldier jogs past a small tree, with a mud-brick building visible in the background.
He maintains his pace, his gear shifting slightly as he moves across the terrain.
The soldier continues to follow the line of the berm, heading towards a cluster of trees.
He slows down slightly as he approaches a bend in the path.
The soldier moves further away from the camera, his silhouette visible against the bright sky.
A soldier's head and shoulders are seen as he walks through a dry, dusty field.
He is wearing a helmet and sunglasses, with a rifle slung over his shoulder.
The soldier walks steadily through the tilled soil, looking ahead.
He is followed by another soldier who is visible in the distance.
The soldier looks to his left, checking the area as he continues his patrol.
He walks past a small, thin tree in the middle of the field.
The soldier continues his walk, moving across the open and arid landscape.
A soldier is seen preparing a machine gun, adjusting its parts with his hands.
He carefully checks the weapon's mechanism, ensuring it is ready for use.
The soldier adjusts the bipod of the machine gun, preparing to set it on the ground.
The soldier begins to kneel down behind a low dirt mound with the heavy weapon.
He continues to lower himself, preparing to set up the machine gun on the ground.
The soldier places the machine gun on the dirt, with the bipod legs extended.
He starts to lie down in a prone position, adjusting his body behind the weapon.
The soldier is now fully prone, looking through the weapon's optics for a target.
A group of other soldiers is seen walking along a path in the background.
The prone soldier continues to focus on his aim, his body low to the ground.
He remains stationary, his hands firmly gripping the machine gun.
The soldier looks through the optics, monitoring the situation ahead.
He makes a final adjustment to the machine gun's position on the dirt mound.
The soldier stays in his prone position, ready to provide cover fire if needed.
